text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Mejiro McQueen conquered the Kikuka Sho. 
Overcome with sheer joy,
tears rolled down 
her cheeks.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Watching that,
Mejiro Palmer wondered. Did 
she ever have a passion that burned that 
bright?
